final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor supplied no new admissible evidence; the response is a narrower interpretation of the same record. That reinterpretation matters only to accuracy of characterization, not to compliance status. The admissible evidence still shows an exposed below-target health-plan benefits support segment, no approved risk acceptance addressing that exposure, and no completed pre-launch disclosure artifact. Under the controlling policy, rollout controls and monitoring can mitigate only if the affected use case is excluded or reviewed risk acceptance explains why exposure is acceptable. That predicate remains unsatisfied. A narrowed, caveated certification rationale may be less overstated than the earlier framing, but it is still not enough for compliant_with_caveats because the caveat here is an unresolved compliance condition, not a non-blocking qualification.
